[i][UPDATE] 05/27/2021[/i][/b][i] - [/i][b]Hello, fellow Starrydewers! I've come back after a very long hiatus to catch a few mods up to date that people actually still use and found that this had already been migrated over to Content Patcher thanks to [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/migrating-xnb-mods-to-content-patcher-packs.141577/page-6]D. I assume I will be revisiting this at least to put the option of making the Greenhouse smaller to fit everyone's needs. For now, though, it is functional and serves its purpose without all the fancy stuff ALL had to offer. Which means no shops, no activating upgrades, etc. So with this, Advanced Location Loader & Entoarox Framework is no longer needed. Just the common Content Patcher and you're golden. If it says these others are required when you click to download, just ignore it. I just don't know how to change that yet.
 [/b]

Adds a "basement" to the greenhouse to extend your Starrydewing experience. 'Tis about all there is to it. This mod has been beat to death, I know. I made this mod simply because it's an area I had yet to touch upon. Future versions will have a different warp location from the main greenhouse & separate storage space for chests, machines, etc. The layout of the farmable locations already available will stay the same to maintain planted crops. I intend to implement tree planting to designated areas as well. REQUIRES [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/resources/smapi-advanced-location-loader.3619/]Advanced Location Loader[/url] & [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/resources/entoarox-framework.4228/]Entoarox Framework[/url] in which this mod would not be possible as many of my other mods so if you appreciate this mod or any of the other JAC'd counterparts, consider looking in to other incredible works by [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/members/entoarox.624175/]Entoarox[/url]. And of course, a thousand thanks to ConcernedApe for being soo cool as to having such an open mind to share his assets with the community and creating an experience that inspires soo many others. Also, many thanks to my supporters, compulsive endorsers, donors & fellow modders. You guys are awesome!

[b]CHANGELOG:[/b]

Added Miner's Treat to the vending machine. Fixed the price on Mixed & Strawberry seeds based on the official Stardew Wiki. Added fertilizer. Added two "tree rooms" to the left and right containing 15 spots with barriers in each. Both have water sources and Junimo Huts in each where you can purchase saplings.[b] [/b]It is ridiculously big now.

Next version will be focused on re-aligning things so you don't see other rooms you're not in through the viewport so before anyone mentions it, be sure it is already on my mind.


[b][UPDATE] 11/25/16 - [/b]New Version 1.3 added! 

[b]CHANGELOG:[/b]

[b]1st Floor:[/b]
Removed some clutter.

[b]2nd Floor-[/b]
Added: 

Pillars! More bendy walls! A seed dealer to the Junimo hut! Moved the vending machine over a pixel and stocked it! Added more destructible floor tiles for planting more crops! Extended the storage room to the upper-right by a few pixels.

[b][UPDATE] 11/24/16 - [/b]I squashed the bugs but it came at a price.. You may now plant trees anywhere within the greenhouse and any crops all year round. Warps are moved from the left to the right instead in the main room of the greenhouse, the hallway to the second floor has been changed to reflect this as well. The second floor of crops should be cleared before updating to the latest version, otherwise you risk losing those crops. Since crops were only seasonal before I figure it's the perfect opportunity to do things right. Outdated version will remain specifically for clearing out your old crops. Secondly, I've added a [NON-ALL] version that you can just throw into your maps folder rather than downloading from external sources (Advanced Location Loader | Entoarox Framework) although some things may not work once implemented (such as the Joja Cola machine). I apologize for the inconvenience. After this time, future updates will not disturb your crops. This was an oversight on my part. Enjoy and feel free to report in the comment section. Also feel free to endorse and whatnot, it's much appreciated! Happy Thanksgiving!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/0v4FGbcl.jpg[/img]

[b][UPDATE] [/b]New version 1.1 added for 'ease of access' drag and drop file structure. New version extends a bit further in preparation for tree placement compatibility. You're also able to dig up the stone path tiles and plant in those places. Not that you have to, it's just an option. You can easily picaxe that same spot to make it normal again. A member mentioned only crops in season may be planted, I'll be looking into this as well. I removed the old version (pictured above) so if anyone wants the old version I'll reupload it..
